notes: Chosen by hand from the model listing on 2026-10-01; boxes measured from the downloaded 1k glTF (wenart.assets.models.measure_gltf), Z-up metres.
bbox_m is [width, depth, height] in the piece frame after re-orientation (front_axis -> -Y); bbox_model_m / bbox_min_m / bbox_max_m are in the model frame.
origin_offset = model-frame point (bbox centre x, bbox centre y, bbox min z) that lands on the piece origin (footprint centre on the floor).
front_axis_confidence low = the piece has no visible front (tables, plants) or the geometry does not show it; see front_axis_note.

Excluded after inspection: drawer_cabinet (tall (1.88 m) shelving unit with drawers, not a dresser); vintage_cabinet_01 (glass-front china cabinet, not a wardrobe); chinese_cabinet (2.87 m tall display cabinet, taller than a room); chinese_sofa (bench-like wooden daybed with a low back rail; three sofas is the limit per type); chinese_armchair (1.59 m high-back ceremonial chair; scaled to a 0.9 m footprint it is 1.75 m tall).

Milestone 7 (docs/milestone7.md §6.3): styles = style families of wenart.style.vocabulary.STYLE_FAMILIES or neutral, tagged on 2026-10-03 from GET https://api.polyhaven.com/info/<id> (tags, description, attributes) and, for the ten models the Milestone 6 renders show, from those renders; the thumbnails (cdn.polyhaven.com) were not reachable from the session. A family is claimed only when the tags or the description say it; style_note gives the words. refit takes a model only when its styles contain the project's family or neutral.

Milestone 7: beds carry has_mattress; old_bed_frame (Old Bed Frame, a tubular metal frame with a wire-mesh base and no mattress) was removed, so bed_single is parametric until the Objaverse library adds one.
